grades.quote: Xv6 trap handling proceeds in four stages: hardware actions taken by the RISC-V CPU, some assembly instructions that prepare the way for kernel C code, a C function that decides what to do with the trap, and the system call or device-driver service routine.
grades.reason: Chapter introduction to xv6 trap handling and its stages, including the first assembly handler (vector). It never mentions sscratch or what it does at trap entry, so it only gives general context.
